DitherContours.lines: How many contour lines from the lowest ground to the highest, 4 to 32.
DitherContours.scale: Size of the hills: higher packs more of them in.
DitherContours.index: Every how many lines one is drawn heavier, as on a survey map. 0 draws them all the same.
DitherContours.relief: How strongly the slopes facing away from the light are shaded, 0 to 1.
